 cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                         \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                         \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__, \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                             \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                            \\\n        }                                                                  \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Thread block shape: x is the contiguous dimension, so a warp reads consecutive doubles\nconstexpr unsigned int BLOCK_X = 32;\nconstexpr unsigned int BLOCK_Y = 8;\n// Largest gridDim.z guaranteed on all CUDA devices; deeper z extents use a grid-stride loop\nconstexpr size_t MAX_GRID_Z = 65535;\n\n// 3D index calculation\n__host__ __device__ inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions\n__device__ double computeLaplacian(const double* __restrict__ c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                                   const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n\n    const double cxx = (c[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)] -\n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dx * dx);\n    const double cyy = (c[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)] -\n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dy * dy);\n    const double czz = (c[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, ny)] -\n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dz * dz);\n\n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential (one thread per cell)\n__global__ void computeChemicalPotentialKernel(const double* __restrict__ c, double* __restrict__ mu,\n                                               const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                                               const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                                               const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    const size_t x = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t y = blockIdx.y * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.y) + threadIdx.y;\n    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;\n\n    for (size_t z = blockIdx.z; z < nz; z += gridDim.z) {\n        const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n        const double cv = c[idx];\n\n        mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB)\n                 + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                 - gamma * computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step (one thread per cell)\n__global__ void cahnHilliardUpdateKernel(double* __restrict__ cnew, const double* __restrict__ cold,\n                                         const double* __restrict__ mu,\n                                         const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                                         const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {\n    const size_t x = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t y = blockIdx.y * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.y) + threadIdx.y;\n    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;\n\n    for (size_t z = blockIdx.z; z < nz; z += gridDim.z) {\n        const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n        cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + dt * D *\n                   computeLaplacian(mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n    }\n}\n\n// Initialize concentration field (one thread per cell)\n__global__ void initializeConcentrationKernel(double* __restrict__ c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t x = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t y = blockIdx.y * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.y) + threadIdx.y;\n    if (x >= nx || y >= ny) return;\n\n    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;\n    for (size_t z = blockIdx.z; z < nz; z += gridDim.z) {\n        const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n        // Generate pseudo-random value in [-1, 1]\n        const size_t linear_id = idx;\n        const double pseudo = ((((linear_id + 1) * 1299709) % vol) / static_cast<double>(vol));\n        c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;\n    }\n}\n\n// Launch configuration covering an nx * ny * nz grid\nstatic dim3 gridFor(const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    return dim3(static_cast<unsigned int>((nx + BLOCK_X - 1) / BLOCK_X),\n                static_cast<unsigned int>((ny + BLOCK_Y - 1) / BLOCK_Y),\n                static_cast<unsigned int>(std::min(nz, MAX_GRID_Z)));\n}\n\n// Host-side launchers\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const double* cold, double* mu,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    if (nx == 0 || ny == 0 || nz == 0) return;\n    computeChemicalPotentialKernel<<<gridFor(nx, ny, nz), dim3(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y, 1)>>>(\n        cold, mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nvoid cahnHilliardUpdate(double* cnew, const double* cold, const double* mu,\n                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {\n    if (nx == 0 || ny == 0 || nz == 0) return;\n    cahnHilliardUpdateKernel<<<gridFor(nx, ny, nz), dim3(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y, 1)>>>(\n        cnew, cold, mu, nx, ny, nz, D, dt, dx, dy, dz);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nvoid initializeConcentration(double* c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    if (nx == 0 || ny == 0 || nz == 0) return;\n    initializeConcentrationKernel<<<gridFor(nx, ny, nz), dim3(BLOCK_X, BLOCK_Y, 1)>>>(c, nx, ny, nz);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Check for NaN or Inf\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field\n    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded\n    double minVal = c[0];\n    double maxVal = c[0];\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n\n    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds\n    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions\ndouble computeLaplacian(const std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n    \n    const double cxx = (c[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dx * dx);\n    const double cyy = (c[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dy * dy);\n    const double czz = (c[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dz * dz);\n    \n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const std::vector<double>& c, std::vector<double>& mu,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                const double cv = c[idx];\n                \n                mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) \n                         + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                         - gamma * computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step\nvoid cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,\n                        const std::vector<double>& mu,\n                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + dt * D * \n                           computeLaplacian(mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Initialize concentration field\nvoid initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                // Generate pseudo-random value in [-1, 1]\n                const size_t linear_id = z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n                const double pseudo = ((((linear_id + 1) * 1299709) % vol) / static_cast<double>(vol));\n                c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Check for NaN or Inf\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field\n    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded\n    double minVal = c[0];\n    double maxVal = c[0];\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds\n    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of time steps (default: 20)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 64;\n    size_t ny = 0;\n    size_t nz = 0;\n    int iterations = 20;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"Cahn-Hilliard Phase Separation Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Time steps: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Physical parameters\n    const double dx = 1.0;\n    const double dy = 1.0;\n    const double dz = 1.0;\n    const double dt = 0.01;\n    const double e_AA = -(2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double e_BB = -(2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double e_AB = (2.0 / 9.0);\n    const double gamma = 0.5;\n    const double D = 1.0;\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate arrays\n    std::vector<double> cold(gridSize);\n    std::vector<double> cnew(gridSize);\n    std::vector<double> mu(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize concentration field\n    printf(\"Initializing concentration field...\\n\");\n    initializeConcentration(cold, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run simulation\n    printf(\"Running Cahn-Hilliard simulation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int t = 0; t < iterations; ++t) {\n        // Compute chemical potential\n        computeChemicalPotential(cold, mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, \n                                gamma, e_AA, e_BB, e_AB);\n        \n        // Update concentration\n        cahnHilliardUpdate(cnew, cold, mu, nx, ny, nz, D, dt, dx, dy, dz);\n        \n        // Swap buffers\n        std::swap(cold, cnew);\n    }\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(cold, \"Concentration\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(cold, nx, ny, nz);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n Blocks are 32×8, with x as the contiguous dimension. A grid-stride loop covers z extents above the 65535 grid limit.\n- **Data stays on the GPU:** the two field buffers swap pointers each step, with no host transfers in the loop. The field is copied back only when `-r` or `-v` needs it.\n- **Unconditional CUDA:** CMake enables the CUDA language and compiles `cahn_hilliard.cpp` as CUDA source. The file keeps its name, so no new files are needed.\n- **Host flags:** `-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra` still apply to the host side, forwarded through `-Xcompiler` under nvcc.\n\n**Correctness:** I built the original in `/tmp` and compared hashes on five grids, including non-cubic sizes, a z extent above 65535, and a single cell. All five match exactly. Timing is in the table below.\n\n| Grid, 20 steps | CPU (original) | CUDA | Speedup |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 256³ | 1995 ms (168 MCUPS) | 126 ms (2663 MCUPS) | ~16× |\n| 512³ | 21424 ms (125 MCUPS) | 884 ms (3037 MCUPS) | ~24× |\n\n**Decisions to review:**\n- **FMA contraction is disabled (`-fmad=false`).** With default settings, nvcc fuses multiply-adds and the result drifts about 1e-15. The original's hash also changes under contraction. With contraction off, both the original and the CUDA build give `d49bfc3f9a5eefeb` on the 64³ test. The kernels are memory-bound, so this costs little.\n- **`CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` defaults to `native`**, which needs CMake 3.24 (so `cmake_minimum_required` is now 3.24) and a GPU present at configure time.
